architecture: The existing model agent calls the Harness CLI; the Harness never calls a model.

windows_to_wsl_tool_call.path: Windows PowerShell -> wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-24.04 --exec bash -> scripts/harness-tool doctor --sandbox
windows_to_wsl_tool_call.noninteractive_path_discovery: The launcher finds the standard per-user Bun installation when PATH omits it.
windows_to_wsl_tool_call.execution_environment: Approved tool execution outside the outer sandbox; Harness namespace isolation remains enabled.

implemented_scope: Domain revalidation of current checks on interpretation revision and verification
Advisory check retirement and monotonic reactivation
Owned worker startup error handling and explicit per-job cancellation
Stable paginated Run discovery, recovery summaries and history
Local readiness diagnostics and generic checkout CLI launcher
External agent calling instructions and GitHub CI configuration
limitations: No external model-agent quality or speed benchmark was run.
Windows-to-WSL transport was tested; Windows-native Harness execution was not.
GitHub Actions configuration was added locally; remote CI has not run.
Capture recovery is explicit and recoverable, not automatic deletion of all orphaned files.
Same-user tamper-resistant certification remains outside the local-advisory scope.
